ascension.watched: "{creature} is ascending — climbing out of your pocket and into the sky, becoming a minor god that will reshape the world you live in. Step back. This was always where it was going. You just got to hold it on the way up."

"A god is being made, and you made it, and now you'll live under it. A temple's rising somewhere. Part of your world tilts to follow. It remembers your choices — all of them — and it will govern according to who you were when you raised it. Sleep on that. It will."

"Apotheosis. The bond doesn't break so much as graduate — it goes from yours to the world's. You don't lose {creature}. You lose the part where {creature} was only yours. That part's gone up with it. Wave. It might wave back. It might not need to anymore."
bark.force.chaos.ally_down: It laughs, which is the worst part.
bark.force.chaos.crit: That wasn't supposed to be possible. Tell it that.
bark.force.chaos.defeat: The dice came up wrong. They do that. That's the deal.
bark.force.chaos.turn_start: It rolled the dice and ate them.
bark.force.chaos.victory: Even it isn't sure what just happened. It's having a wonderful time.
bark.force.cosmos.ally_down: The shield broke a moment too late. It logs the failure. It corrects.
bark.force.cosmos.crit: Order, applied with great precision, to your skull.
bark.force.cosmos.defeat: The pattern broke. Even perfect things do.
bark.force.cosmos.low_hp: The wards are thin. It is not afraid. It is calculating.
bark.force.cosmos.turn_start: The geometry holds. So does it.
bark.force.cosmos.victory: All accounted for. As it should be.
bark.force.eros.ally_down: It reaches for them. The reach falls short. It does not stop reaching.
bark.force.eros.crit: Even mercy has a breaking strain. You found it.
bark.force.eros.defeat: It gave too much away. It always does. That's the whole shape of it.
bark.force.eros.low_hp: Still blooming. Out of spite, mostly.
bark.force.eros.turn_start: It would rather not. It will anyway.
bark.force.eros.victory: It tends to its own first. Yours can wait, or rot.
bark.force.gaia.ally_down: It plants its feet over the body. Nothing else gets through.
bark.force.gaia.defeat: Even stone wears down. Slowly. This was not slow.
bark.force.gaia.low_hp: Cracked. Not fallen. There's a difference, and you'll learn it.
bark.force.gaia.turn_start: The mountain takes its turn. Eventually.
bark.force.gaia.victory: It outlasted you. That was always the plan.
bark.force.ouranos.ally_down: It's already three steps from the grief.
bark.force.ouranos.crit: You didn't see it. That's the point of it.
bark.force.ouranos.defeat: Too quick to live, this once.
bark.force.ouranos.low_hp: Faster now, out of desperation. Still faster than you.
bark.force.ouranos.turn_start: It moved before the turn began. Rude.
bark.force.ouranos.victory: Gone before the dust settled. It hates a long goodbye.
bark.force.thanatos.crit: It didn't kill you faster. It killed you more.
bark.force.thanatos.defeat: Even death takes a night off. Don't get used to it.
bark.force.thanatos.low_hp: Closer to its element, not further from it. Careful.
bark.force.thanatos.turn_start: The end is in no hurry. It can afford to wait.
bark.force.thanatos.victory: It collects what falls. It always collects.
bark.mortals.feared: "Don't look at it. Don't let it look at you."
bark.mortals.low: "You're new. Try not to die where I have to look at it."
bark.mortals.notorious: "Please. My children. We have nothing left to ascend."
bark.mortals.rising: "I've heard of you. None of it was reassuring."
bark.mortals.worshipful: "Bless me, throne-walker. Or at least don't curse me. I'll take either."
bark.region.astral_tier: "Form your intent in triplicate. The cosmos does not process verbal blasphemy."
"Your ascension request is in the queue. Current wait time: one mortal lifetime."
"Order is not cruel. Order is simply thorough. Please have your soul ready for inspection."
"We refilled the thrones lawfully last age. It went poorly, but correctly."
"Take a number. The number is also a sin. Most things here are."
bark.region.mournmarch: "Death isn't an ending here, dear. It's a budgeting problem."
"We don't bury our dead. We invest them."
"You'll fit in nicely. You already smell of unfinished business."
"Grief is just power you haven't reabsorbed yet. Chin up."
"The Court is always recruiting. The Court is only recruiting. There's nothing else to do down here."
bark.region.sunder: "I had a name this morning! Now I have three, and they argue!"
"The rules took the day off. We're filling in. We're doing a TERRIBLE job. Isn't it WONDERFUL?"
"Drink this. It tastes like a color that hasn't been invented. You'll love it. You'll become it."
"Up is a suggestion here. So's your spine. Loosen up!"
"We mutated the well last week. Now it gives advice. Bad advice! But so confident!"
bark.region.threshold: "Another god-botherer with a parts bag. They get younger every apocalypse."
"Mind the Graveyard district after dark. Some of the headstones have opinions now."
"You can buy anything in Threshold. Whether you should is between you and whatever's left of your conscience."
"I sold a man a soul once. His own. He didn't notice till Tuesday."
"Welcome to the last mortal city. We're very proud of the 'last.'"
"The Arena's that way. Bring a creature. Bring two. Bring a will, while you're at it."
bark.region.verdant_glut: "Eat the fruit, traveler — oh, not that one, that one eats back."
"We tend everything that grows. Even the things that shouldn't. Especially those."
"Be kind to your creatures. The ones you love don't end up on the table. Mostly."
"It's beautiful here, isn't it? It's also slowly digesting the eastern road. Both things are true."
"Stay for the harvest. Leave before the harvest stays for you."
bark.role.aggressor.ally_down: It does not mourn. It accelerates.
bark.role.aggressor.crit: It hit a place that doesn't grow back.
Clean through. The follow-through was unnecessary, and lovely.
bark.role.aggressor.defeat: It went down swinging at the air.
bark.role.aggressor.low_hp: It has stopped guarding. It has stopped caring.
bark.role.aggressor.turn_start: Point it at something. It'll do the rest.
bark.role.aggressor.victory: Nothing left to hit. It seems disappointed.
bark.role.controller.ally_down: One piece off the board. It recalculates. It does not flinch.
bark.role.controller.crit: The trap was set three turns ago. You just found it.
bark.role.controller.defeat: Out-thought. Even it can appreciate that, distantly.
bark.role.controller.turn_start: It doesn't beat you. It arranges for you to lose.
Patience. Then the board is its.
bark.role.controller.victory: It never raised its voice. It rarely does.
bark.role.support.ally_down: Too slow. It knows. It will carry that.
bark.role.support.crit: Even the kind ones have a limit, and you just met it.
bark.role.support.defeat: It spent its last on someone else. Typical.
bark.role.support.low_hp: It's still trying to heal the others. That's the tragedy of it.
bark.role.support.turn_start: Hold the line. Mend the wound. Buy the second.
It keeps the others standing. Thankless. Vital.
bark.role.support.victory: It checks the others first. Always the others first.
battle.boss.prefight: "The Act boss stirs — a dead god's echo, throned in its own ruin, that has lost worse fights than this one and woke up anyway. You're not here to win. You're here to find out the price of winning. Begin."

"A god used to lose for a living, before it died. Now its sleeping echo blocks your climb, slow and certain and unbothered by your résumé. Make it remember how to lose. It's been a while. It's out of practice. So, frankly, are you, at this weight."

"Apotheosis-tier. The thing across the circle is becoming a god as you fight it, phase by phase — Opening, Pressure, Desperation, and the part where it stops being a creature. Pace yourself. It won't pace itself. It's busy ascending."
battle.boss.victory: "It's down — the echo of a god, felled by a nobody with a parts bag and a grudge. Savor it quietly. The big dead don't appreciate gloating, and the ones still climbing toward you are taking notes."

"Beaten, the boss dissolves back into the region it haunted, leaving the way up open and the air a little emptier. You climbed past a god today. The graveyard noticed. The graveyard always notices when someone gets above their plot."
battle.defeat: Your squad is broken. You are not dead — only taught.
Defeat. Gather what's left of them. Some of it fits in a jar.
You lost. The world notes it, files it, and waits for you to try again. It's patient. It's so patient.

"Your squad is broken. You are not dead — only taught. Gather what's left of them; some of it still walks, some of it fits in a jar, all of it is still yours. The world notes the loss, files it, and waits. It's patient. It is so patient. It can out-wait anything but you, if you let it."

"You lost. There's no shine on it and I won't pretend there is. But a loss in this world is rarely the end of you — it's the tuition. Pay attention to what it cost and you'll have bought something. Ignore it and you'll just buy it again, dearer."

"Defeat. The rival walks off wearing the look — the one after the worst part — and you're left counting. Counting's good. Counting is how the taught become the dangerous. Count, rebuild, and come back as the thing they file a loss against."

"Down, but the bond held — the body just needs a minute the world may not give. Get them somewhere safe before the somewhere stops being safe. You're a loss today. 'Today' is the operative word, and it's the only word in this whole place that's ever on your side."
battle.downed: {creature} is down — not gone. Filed for emancipation, pending revival.
{creature} drops. Still breathing. Still yours. Still furious.
{creature} taps out. The bond holds; the body just needs a minute.
"{creature} drops — not gone, just unfit to continue. Filed for revival, breathing, furious, still yours. Get it standing before the fight decides 'down' should mean 'down for good.'"
"{creature} taps out. The bond holds; the body just needs a minute the battlefield rarely grants. Cover the gap. A knockout's only temporary if you survive long enough to make it so."
"Down goes {creature}, eyes still tracking you from the dirt, already plotting the rematch. Knocked out, not lost. There's a whole gulf between those two words, and it's your job to keep them apart."
battle.stalemate: It won't fight. It just sits down and starts telling you about its week.
{creature} declines combat. It would, however, like to vent.
No battle today. It's tired, you're tired, the gods are dead — what's the point, really?
It refuses to raise a claw. There's a dignity in it that you find faintly accusatory.
It came for conversation, not violence. The world is strange at the edges. So is this.
{creature} folds its arms — metaphorically; it has no arms — and simply will not.
battle.start: The circle closes. Only one team walks out whole.
Two squads, one survivor's tally. Begin.
The entropy clock starts ticking the moment you do. Don't dawdle.
"The circle closes. Two teams in; one survivor's tally out. The entropy clock starts the moment you do — so begin, and begin fast."
"Squads square off. Somewhere a god used to watch fights like this for sport. The gods are dead now. The watching, regrettably, continues."
"Blades and verbs and bone. One of these teams walks out whole. The other walks out taught, or doesn't walk out. Choose which, every turn."
battle.victory: They're down. You're up. The math, this time, was kind.
Won. Collect the fallen, count your own, and don't look too pleased.
Victory. The Graveyard goes hungry today. Tomorrow's another ledger.

"They're down. You're up. The math, this time, was kind — and the Graveyard goes hungry today, which only means it'll be hungrier tomorrow. Collect your fallen. Count your own. Don't look too pleased; something always notices when you do."
"Won. The circle clears, the dust settles, and you're the team that walked out whole. Savor it for exactly as long as it takes the next thing to find you. That's about a breath. Use it well."

"Victory. You beat them honestly, or close enough to honestly that the difference is yours to keep. The world files the win, adjusts your notoriety up, and quietly sharpens the next rival to match. Winning is how you summon worse. Congratulations. Truly. Mind the worse."

"Done, and done well. The thing about climbing a graveyard is that every win takes you higher into it — closer to the big dead, the patient ones, the gods who used to lose for a living. You're getting good at this. That should frighten you more than losing ever did."
capture.befriend.fail: It weighed your kindness and found it suspicious. Fair.
Not yet. It's seen what people who smile like that tend to want.
Rejected — gently, which is somehow worse.
It backs away. It has met your kind of mercy before.
The offer hangs in the air, unanswered. It slips into the dark.
capture.befriend.success: It chose you. That'll mean more than any cage ever could.
Offered, not taken. {creature} steps closer of its own will.
Trust, freely given. Try to deserve it. You won't, but try.
It came to your hand. The bond starts warm, this way. They mostly don't.
A friend, not a prisoner. The difference will matter later, on the table.
